text: Cause of the Battle of Cnucha is a title that points to the tale of how Cumhall died. MacKillop names it as the best-known account of that death. Cumhall led the Fianna before his son Fionn mac Cumhaill rose. Goll mac Morna slew Cumhall in the fighting at Cnucha. That hill is Castle Knock, close to Dublin.

okr.objective: Route readers from this title to the tale of the death of Cumhall.
key_results: MacKillop names this title as the best-known account of Cumhall's death.
Cumhall died in the battle at Cnucha, a site near Dublin.
Goll mac Morna dealt the fatal blow in that fight.
